emails.subject: Replacement card still not delivered
emails.body: I requested a replacement card on 12 September. The tracking page has not moved for a week. Please tell me where the card is.
emails.backend_status: Card dispatched 23 Sep; courier shows out for delivery 25 Sep.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. Your replacement card was dispatched on 23 September and the courier shows it out for delivery today, 25 September. We will confirm once it is delivered. We are sorry for the wait.

emails.subject: UPI paisa kat gaya, wapas nahi aaya
emails.body: 22 September ko UPI payment fail hua, paisa account se kat gaya. Abhi tak reversal nahi aaya. Complaint pehle bhi kiya tha.
emails.backend_status: Reversal credited 24 Sep, 18:05. Compensation for one day of delay due.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. The failed UPI payment of 22 September was reversed to your account on 24 September at 18:05. As the reversal was one day late, the compensation due under the RBI timeline will be credited separately. We are sorry for the inconvenience.

emails.subject: On behalf of our director: account restriction after re-KYC
emails.body: Writing on behalf of the account holder. Re-KYC documents were submitted at the branch on 15 September. The account still shows as restricted. Please advise.
emails.backend_status: Re-KYC verified 24 Sep; restriction lifted 24 Sep, 17:30.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. The re-KYC documents were verified on 24 September and the restriction on the account was lifted the same day at 17:30. The account is now fully active. We will reply to the account holder's registered email as well.

emails.subject: Disbursal date for my home loan
emails.body: My builder is asking for the next instalment. The disbursal was approved last week. When will it be paid?
emails.backend_status: Disbursal scheduled 26 Sep after the technical visit report.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. The next disbursal on your home loan is scheduled for 26 September, following the technical visit report. We will send the payment confirmation to you and to the builder once it is made.

emails.subject: Voucher redeem kiya, mila nahi
emails.body: Reward points se voucher redeem kiya 18 September ko. Points kat gaye par voucher email mein nahi aaya.
emails.backend_status: Voucher issued 24 Sep; resent to registered email.
emails.draft_reply: Thank you for writing to us. The voucher you redeemed on 18 September was issued on 24 September and has been sent again to your registered email address. Please check your inbox, including the spam folder. We are sorry for the delay.
